estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands pouring soil into a plastic bucket with drainage holes in the bottom, until it is one third full
Close-up of a man's hands placing sprouted seed potatoes, shoots facing up, on the soil inside the bucket; the small mascot figurine sits on the rim of the bucket
Close-up of a man's hands adding soil around young green potato shoots growing inside the bucket
Taro leaf with pale, feather-shaped mottled patches along the veins (dasheen mosaic virus)
Sweet potato vine with heart-shaped leaves next to freshly dug sweet potatoes on the soil
Harvested onions with dry papery outer skins on a wooden table in a sunny backyard
Garlic heads of different sizes with white, pink and purple skins on a rustic wooden table; the small mascot figurine stands on the table next to them
Pieces of ginger rhizome with green shoots planted in loose, rich, well-drained soil
